title: Yields Hit A 24-Year High And Metals Feel The Pressure
speaker: Jake Sweeney

macro_themes.view: The US 10-year reached 5.365%, highest since 2002, and that is what is pressuring gold and silver.

calls.condition: If yields keep inching up, next major level 5.426%
calls.reason: Yields failed to break back to the trend line and keep wicking higher to new 24-year highs.
calls.quote: the next major level uh for the US 10year is if it keeps inching up is this 5.426%

calls.condition: Below the long-term trend line from the Apr 21 2025 high, expects support near 4,023; would buy around 3,895-3,700. Bulls need a close back above the swing-low pivot
calls.reason: Daily bear flag broke down about 2% on rising yields; price tested the long-term trend line and bounced.
calls.quote: I like to wait for cheaper prices down here 3,895 even down to 3700. Um, that would be my area for great buy opportunity on …

calls.condition: Needs to reclaim the $61.02 pivot; major resistance at 64.36-65.28; if the trend line from the Nov 20 2025 low breaks, buy near $54.46
calls.reason: Daily bear flag broke down 2.77% into trend-line support from the Nov 2025 low; the down-sloping line from the Mar 2 2026 high caps rallies.
calls.quote: great buy level around this $5446 an ounce should we get down there.

calls.reason: Oil has been trickling lower since Sep 18 highs, with a doji today; support at the rising trend line around 87-88 and the 38.2% retrace at 87.07; resistance at 93.64 (0.5 Fib).
calls.quote: I do expect oil to stay in this area for still quite some time, some chop um before we see some sharper falls

calls.reason: Higher lows since the early-August low with a steep rising trend line; upside resistance at 11.29-11.32, the 11.48 polarity level and a four-touch down trend line near 11.80.
calls.quote: for longer play upside for UNNG, this trend line ... X marks a spot at about 1180ish for that resistance.

calls.condition: Has to reclaim 40.21 to turn up; a drop to 39.20-39.40 could produce a large bounce
calls.reason: A weekly topping tail in mid-September has played out bearishly and price failed to reclaim 40.21.
calls.quote: I noticed a weekly topping tail a strong bearish signal and since this top ... we've been going down

notes: Host says 'great Wednesday' -> 2026-10-07 (listing said 10-08). 'UNNG' = UNG (natural gas fund, no canonical code in spec). 'CPR' = CPER (United States Copper Index Fund); its levels '4021', '4140-4150', '3920-3940' are read as $40.21, $41.40-41.50, $39.20-39.40. UNG levels '11:29 1130', '11:48' are read as $11.29-11.30, $11.48. Gold and silver 'medium bullish' reflects their 'great buy' zones, which are conditional on lower prices.
